notes.text: Mixed sets: Schemes and Plots, Masterminds and Commanders, Heroes and Allies and the groups each come from one pool
Mixed sets: lay out every Wound, Bindings and recruit stack, and shuffle all Bystanders together
Mixed sets: the players choose S.H.I.E.L.D. or HYDRA starting decks

glossary.name: X-Men
glossary.summary: A Hero team. In the core box its members are Cyclops, Emma Frost, Gambit, Rogue, Storm and Wolverine.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Brotherhood
glossary.summary: An Ally team of mutants who believe their kind should rule. In Villains its members are Juggernaut, Magneto, Mystique and Sabretooth.

glossary.name: Crime Syndicate
glossary.summary: An Ally team of street-level crime bosses and hired killers. In Villains its members are Bullseye and Kingpin.

glossary.name: Sinister Six
glossary.summary: An Ally team of Spider-Man's foes who band together against him. In Villains its members are Dr. Octopus, Electro, Green Goblin, Kraven, Mysterio and Venom.

glossary.name: Covert
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who prefer trickery and careful plans to open force.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Instinct
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who trust their gut and their senses in close combat.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Ranged
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters who deal damage from a distance, by any kind of projected power.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Tech
glossary.summary: A Hero class of fighters whose power comes from gear and science rather than the body.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Covert
glossary.summary: An Ally class that wins through deceit, cunning schemes and subtle powers.

glossary.name: Instinct
glossary.summary: An Ally class that relies on ferocity, fast reactions and keen senses.

glossary.name: Ranged
glossary.summary: An Ally class that attacks from afar with blasts, beams and elemental or mental power.

glossary.name: Strength
glossary.summary: An Ally class whose power is raw might, iron will or command of others.

glossary.name: Always Leads
glossary.summary: Names the one Villain or Henchman Group this Mastermind brings to every game. That group takes one of the setup's group slots; random draws fill the rest.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Ambush
glossary.summary: Triggers as this Villain arrives in the city from the Villain Deck. When its arrival shoves another Villain out of the city, resolve that escape before this effect.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Escape
glossary.summary: Triggers when this Villain is shoved past the final city space and escapes, in addition to the standard escape penalties.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Fight
glossary.summary: Triggers when a player spends enough Attack to defeat this card.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Master Strike
glossary.summary: Drawing a Master Strike from the Villain Deck makes the Mastermind act in person: resolve the Master Strike line on its card. The Strike card is then KO'd.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Mastermind Tactic
glossary.summary: Beating the Mastermind's Attack wins one of its four face-down Tactics at random: keep it for Victory Points and do its Fight effect. Take all four to win.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Rescue a Bystander
glossary.summary: Add a Bystander from the shared Bystander stack to your Victory Pile, where it scores at game end. This never frees a Bystander a Villain holds; defeat that Villain for it.
glossary.box: Marvel Legendary First Edition core box

glossary.name: Ambush
glossary.summary: Triggers as this Adversary arrives in the city. If its arrival pushes another Adversary out, resolve that overrun first.

glossary.name: Dodge
glossary.summary: On your turn you can discard this card from your hand to draw a replacement, ignoring its other text. Dodging is not playing the card.

glossary.name: Elusive
glossary.summary: You can only fight this Adversary once you have made at least the listed amount of Recruit this turn. That Recruit stays yours to spend.

glossary.name: Fight
glossary.summary: Triggers when a player spends enough Attack to defeat this card.

glossary.name: Overrun
glossary.summary: Triggers when this Adversary is pushed out past the last city space, after it KOs a cheap Ally from the Lair and any guarded Bystanders cost each player a discard.

glossary.name: Plot Twist
glossary.summary: Drawing a Plot Twist from the Adversary Deck moves the Commander's plan forward: resolve the Twist line on the Plot, then KO the Twist unless the Plot says otherwise.

glossary.name: X-Treme Attack
glossary.summary: This Adversary gets +1 Attack for every other Adversary with X-Treme Attack in the city, so these teams grow stronger together.

rulesReason.text: Villains rules: the Plot is Crush HYDRA
